title: Pixel Index custom furniture manifest
description: Shape of the manifest.json inside a custom-furniture upload zip for POST /api/v1/assets?assetKind=furniture (#101, #105). Mirrors services/api/src/assets/manifest.ts's validateManifestShape() field-for-field, including its permissiveness: unknown properties are not rejected, because the decode logic that actually enforces this contract doesn't reject them either. See docs/custom-asset-zip-contract.md for the zip-level rules (manifest.json location, PNG resolution) this schema doesn't cover.

id.description: Uppercase letters, digits, underscore, starting with a letter.

file.description: PNG path, resolved relative to manifest.json's own directory in the zip.

groupType.description: Defaults to "rotation" when omitted, matching decodeFurnitureZip()'s rootNode().

id.description: Uppercase letters, digits, underscore, starting with a letter. This is the requested asset id — pixel-index suffixes it (_2, _3, ...) on collision.

category.description: Pixel-agents' current 7-value category set, kept as-is for upstream parity (#105) — storage included even though no bundled manifest uses it today.

type.description: "asset" is one placeable variant with its own PNG; "group" fans out into rotation/state/animation members, each recursively an asset or a nested group.

file.description: Required, and only meaningful, when type is "asset".

groupType.description: Only meaningful when type is "group". Defaults to "rotation" when omitted.

members.description: Required, and only meaningful, when type is "group".
